name: Liquid Glass
pitch: Your model mix becomes light, held in deep glass and measured in liquid.
tradeoff: Atmospheric depth uses more space and GPU work than a compact table.
fontWhy: Host gives the brand softness, Instrument keeps labels crisp, and Geist Mono supplies fixed-width tabular numerals.
logoIdea: A travelling droplet pulls a horizontal trace upward into its meniscus.
sliderIdea: Two refractive glass beads contain a luminous liquid window inside a thick glass tube.
signatureMotion: Share-weighted light pools drift and remix while liquid tubes settle with a soft slosh.
